warnings: Do not convert federal testing, follow-on contracts, OEM discussions or NATO DIANA selection into fleet-wide Royal Canadian Navy adoption; ultimate ownership is not established by the cited sources.

Keep SilentEdge evidence separate from newer IntentHunter or electronic-defence marketing; do not state broad CAF deployment, patent scope, FIDO status or performance superiority without product-specific corroboration; ultimate ownership is unresolved.

Do not split the Win-Shield Devices brand from Win-Shield Medical Devices Inc.; do not infer NATO or CAF adoption, or generalize Health Canada status and performance from one product to the full portfolio.

Do not convert Ripple's development objectives or the Supercluster's Canadian-owned-solution language into completed deployment, independently verified performance or ultimate Canadian ownership of Visual Defence.

Keep Compusult Limited distinct from Compusult Systems Incorporated and Compusult Europe B.V.; do not treat company-authored NATO or customer statements, Ripple objectives or an incident-response contract as proof of every defence deployment.

Exclude 'forever unbreakable,' 'only,' performance-multiple and NATO-validated/adopted language unless separately corroborated; DIANA selection is not procurement, and the company's '100% Canadian' statement is not independent beneficial-ownership evidence.

Do not publish company-stated TRLs, 'first commercially available' status, defence readiness, passive-radar performance or medical-imaging outcomes as independently verified; DND interest is not operational adoption.

Do not confuse this Canadian corporation with Dutch vendor Single Quantum at singlequantum.com; do not attribute QEYnet technology or University of Waterloo laboratory claims to this company, and do not convert an IDEaS proof of concept into deployment.

Do not infer Canadian beneficial ownership from headquarters, merge the Belgian subsidiary into the Canadian entity, or convert environmental-monitoring performance testimonials and Ripple objectives into verified defence deployment.

Facility configuration, SFOC scope, defence-customer outcomes and NATO DIANA testing-centre status are company- or supplier-asserted and remain unconfirmed until independent named records are recovered.
